response.sql: WITH track_rates AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, Bytes * 1.0 / Milliseconds as rate FROM Track WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL), media_type_averages AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(rate) as avg_rate FROM track_rates GROUP BY MediaTypeId), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(rate) as avg_rate FROM track_rates) SELECT mt.Name, mta.avg_rate as rate, mta.avg_rate - oa.avg_rate as exceeds_average FROM MediaType mt JOIN media_type_averages mta ON mt.MediaTypeId = mta.MediaTypeId CROSS JOIN overall_average oa WHERE mta.avg_rate > oa.avg_rate ORDER BY mt.Name
